summary.id: Ermera, di pegunungan bagian barat, adalah jantung kopi Timor-Leste. Ibu kotanya Gleno. Dengan sekitar 138.000 penduduk pada 2022, Ermera adalah munisipalitas dengan penduduk terbanyak setelah Dili.

text.tet: Ermera iha foho matak sira iha Dili nia loro-monu sul, no la iha tasi. Ninia foho-lolon malirin no hetan udan di'ak, no ai-hun aas ne'ebé fó mahon taka to'os kafé nian. Gleno, kapitál, iha rai-kuak ida, no vila tuan Ermera iha foho aas liu. Letefoho no Atsabe mak área aas liu balu. Estrada kloot sira liga knua sira, no iha tempu udan rai-halai bele taka sira. Munisípiu ne'e iha postu administrativu lima: Atsabe, Ermera, Hatulia, Letefoho no Railaco.
text.pt: Ermera fica nas montanhas verdes a sudoeste de Díli e não tem costa. As encostas são frescas e recebem boa chuva, e árvores altas de sombra cobrem as hortas de café. Gleno, a capital, fica num vale, enquanto a antiga vila de Ermera fica mais acima, nas colinas. Letefoho e Atsabe estão entre as zonas mais altas. Estradas estreitas ligam as aldeias, e na época das chuvas os deslizamentos podem cortá-las. O município tem cinco postos administrativos: Atsabe, Ermera, Hatulia, Letefoho e Railaco.
text.en: Ermera lies in the green mountains south-west of Dili and has no sea coast. Its slopes are cool and receive good rain, and tall shade trees cover the coffee gardens. Gleno, the capital, sits in a valley, while the old town of Ermera stands higher in the hills. Letefoho and Atsabe are among the highest areas. Narrow roads link the villages, and in the rainy season landslides can block them. The municipality has five administrative posts: Atsabe, Ermera, Hatulia, Letefoho and Railaco.
text.id: Ermera terletak di pegunungan hijau di barat daya Dili dan tidak memiliki pantai. Lerengnya sejuk dan cukup hujan, dan pohon-pohon peneduh yang tinggi menaungi kebun kopi. Gleno, ibu kotanya, berada di lembah, sedangkan kota lama Ermera terletak lebih tinggi di perbukitan. Letefoho dan Atsabe termasuk daerah tertinggi. Jalan-jalan sempit menghubungkan desa-desa, dan pada musim hujan tanah longsor dapat memutusnya. Munisipalitas ini memiliki lima pos administratif: Atsabe, Ermera, Hatulia, Letefoho, dan Railaco.

text.tet: Kafé mai Timór iha tempu koloniál, no iha sékulu 19 nia rohan Portugés haforsa ninia kuda; kompañia boot ida, SAPT, iha plantasaun boot iha Ermera. Ohin loron família barak iha Ermera kuda kafé, liuliu arábika, dala barak iha to'os ki'ik iha ai-hun ne'ebé halo mahon nia okos. Kruzamentu naturál ida entre arábika no robusta ne'ebé ema hetan iha Timór, 'Híbridu Timór', hasoru moras ferruzen kafé nian, no ema iha mundu tomak uza nia atu hadi'a kafé. Kafé mak nasaun nia esportasaun boot liu se la konta mina-rai no gás, no kafé barak mai husi Ermera.
text.pt: O café chegou a Timor no tempo colonial e, no fim do século XIX, os portugueses fomentaram o seu cultivo; uma grande companhia, a SAPT, tinha grandes plantações em Ermera. Hoje, a maioria das famílias de Ermera cultiva café, sobretudo arábica, muitas vezes em pequenas hortas à sombra de árvores. Um cruzamento natural de arábica com robusta encontrado em Timor, o 'Híbrido de Timor', resiste à ferrugem do cafeeiro e é usado no melhoramento do café em todo o mundo. O café é a principal exportação do país além do petróleo e do gás, e grande parte vem de Ermera.
text.en: Coffee came to Timor in colonial times, and in the late 1800s the Portuguese pushed its cultivation; a large company, SAPT, owned big plantations in Ermera. Today most families in Ermera grow coffee, mainly arabica, often in small gardens under shade trees. A natural cross between arabica and robusta found on Timor, the 'Timor Hybrid', resists coffee leaf rust and is used in coffee breeding around the world. Coffee is the country's main export besides oil and gas, and much of it comes from Ermera.
text.id: Kopi datang ke Timor pada masa kolonial, dan pada akhir abad ke-19 Portugis mendorong penanamannya; sebuah perusahaan besar, SAPT, memiliki perkebunan luas di Ermera. Kini sebagian besar keluarga di Ermera menanam kopi, terutama arabika, sering di kebun kecil di bawah pohon peneduh. Persilangan alami antara arabika dan robusta yang ditemukan di Timor, 'Hibrida Timor', tahan terhadap penyakit karat daun kopi dan dipakai untuk pemuliaan kopi di seluruh dunia. Kopi adalah ekspor utama negeri ini selain minyak dan gas, dan sebagian besar berasal dari Ermera.

text.tet: Iha 2022, ema maizumenus 138 000 hela iha Ermera, barak liu munisípiu seluk hotu, se la konta Dili. Ema ko'alia Mambai iha Ermera nia parte barak, no Kemak iha Atsabe nia sorin, ne'ebé uluk mak reinu Kemak tuan ida nia sede. Aleinde kafé, família sira kuda batar, modo no ai-fuan no hakiak animál. Durante tempu ku'u kafé, maizumenus husi tinan nia klaran, família tomak servisu iha to'os, no sosa-na'in no kooperativa sira sosa kafé-fuan ka kafé maran. Tan ne'e, presu kafé iha merkadu mundiál importante ba uma-kain barak iha ne'e.
text.pt: Cerca de 138 000 pessoas viviam em Ermera em 2022, mais do que em qualquer outro município exceto Díli. O mambai fala-se em grande parte de Ermera, e o kemak à volta de Atsabe, que foi sede de um antigo reino kemak. Além do café, as famílias cultivam milho, legumes e fruta e criam animais. Durante a colheita do café, a partir de meados do ano, famílias inteiras trabalham nas hortas, e compradores e cooperativas recolhem o fruto ou o grão seco. Por isso, os preços do café nos mercados mundiais importam a muitas famílias daqui.
text.en: About 138,000 people lived in Ermera in 2022, more than in any other municipality except Dili. Mambai is spoken in much of Ermera, and Kemak around Atsabe, which was the seat of an old Kemak kingdom. Besides coffee, families grow maize, vegetables and fruit and raise animals. During the coffee harvest, from about the middle of the year, whole families work in the gardens, and buyers and cooperatives collect the cherries or the dried beans. Coffee prices on world markets therefore matter to many households here.
text.id: Sekitar 138.000 orang tinggal di Ermera pada 2022, lebih banyak daripada munisipalitas lain kecuali Dili. Bahasa Mambai dipakai di sebagian besar Ermera, dan bahasa Kemak di sekitar Atsabe, yang dulu menjadi pusat sebuah kerajaan Kemak tua. Selain kopi, keluarga menanam jagung, sayuran, dan buah serta memelihara ternak. Selama panen kopi, mulai sekitar pertengahan tahun, seluruh keluarga bekerja di kebun, dan pembeli serta koperasi mengumpulkan buah atau biji kopi kering. Karena itu, harga kopi di pasar dunia penting bagi banyak rumah tangga di sini.

text.tet: Gleno mak vila administrasaun no merkadu nian. Vila tuan Ermera sei iha edifísiu husi tempu koloniál. Railaco, iha estrada husi Dili, mak área kafé dahuluk ne'ebé vizitante barak haree, ho ai-hun mahon nian iha foho sira. Letefoho famozu ho ninia to'os aas no anin malirin, no Atsabe ho kultura Kemak no uma tradisionál. Vizitante sira bele haree oinsá ema ku'u, fase no habai kafé, no prova kafé ne'ebé ema kuda no sona iha fatin ne'e rasik.
text.pt: Gleno é a vila administrativa e de mercado. A antiga vila de Ermera conserva edifícios do tempo colonial. Railaco, na estrada de Díli, é a primeira zona de café que muitos visitantes veem, com árvores de sombra pelas colinas. Letefoho é conhecido pelas hortas altas e pelo ar fresco, e Atsabe pela cultura kemak e pelas casas tradicionais. Os visitantes podem ver como o café é colhido, despolpado e seco, e provar café cultivado e torrado na região.
text.en: Gleno is the administrative and market town. The old town of Ermera keeps buildings from colonial times. Railaco, on the road from Dili, is the first coffee area many visitors see, with shade trees lining the hills. Letefoho is known for its high gardens and cool air, and Atsabe for Kemak culture and traditional houses. Visitors can see how coffee is picked, pulped and dried, and taste coffee grown and roasted locally.
text.id: Gleno adalah kota pemerintahan dan pasar. Kota lama Ermera masih memiliki bangunan dari masa kolonial. Railaco, di jalan dari Dili, adalah daerah kopi pertama yang dilihat banyak pengunjung, dengan pohon peneduh di sepanjang perbukitan. Letefoho terkenal dengan kebun-kebunnya yang tinggi dan udaranya yang sejuk, dan Atsabe dengan budaya Kemak serta rumah-rumah tradisionalnya. Pengunjung dapat melihat bagaimana kopi dipetik, dikupas, dan dijemur, serta mencicipi kopi yang ditanam dan disangrai di daerah itu.

summary.tet: Lautein mak munisípiu iha rohan loro-sa'e liu. Ninia kapitál mak Lospalos, no ema barak ko'alia Fataluku. Iha ne'e iha Parke Nasionál Nino Konis Santana, Lagoa Ira Lalaro, illa Jaku no fatuk-kuak ho rastu tuan tebes husi ema nia moris.
summary.pt: Lautém é o município mais oriental. A capital é Lospalos e a maioria das pessoas fala fataluku. Tem o Parque Nacional Nino Konis Santana, o lago Ira Lalaro, a ilha de Jaco e grutas com vestígios muito antigos de vida humana.
summary.en: Lautém is the easternmost municipality. Its capital is Lospalos, and most people speak Fataluku. It has the Nino Konis Santana National Park, Lake Ira Lalaro, Jaco Island and caves with very old traces of human life.
summary.id: Lautém adalah munisipalitas paling timur. Ibu kotanya Lospalos, dan sebagian besar penduduknya berbahasa Fataluku. Di sini terdapat Taman Nasional Nino Konis Santana, Danau Ira Lalaro, Pulau Jaco, dan gua-gua dengan jejak kehidupan manusia yang sangat tua.

text.tet: Lautein iha Timór nia rohan loro-sa'e. Ninia rai barak mak rai-tetuk fatuk-ahu nian ne'ebé sa'e husi tasi, ho ai-laran, fatuk-kuak no rai-kuak; Lospalos iha rai-tetuk Fuiloro. Bee barak suli iha rai-okos, maibé iha tempu udan Lagoa Ira Lalaro, lagoa boot liu iha nasaun, loke luan iha fatin kuak ida besik Lospalos. Kosta iha tasi-ibun mutin, hanesan Valu besik Tutuala, no knua peskadór Com. Munisípiu ne'e iha postu administrativu lima: Iliomar, Lautein, Lospalos, Luro no Tutuala.
text.pt: Lautém ocupa a ponta leste de Timor. Grande parte é um planalto de calcário, levantado do mar, com florestas, grutas e dolinas; Lospalos fica no planalto de Fuiloro. A água corre sobretudo debaixo da terra, mas na época das chuvas o lago Ira Lalaro, o maior do país, estende-se por uma bacia perto de Lospalos. A costa tem praias brancas, como Valu, perto de Tutuala, e a aldeia piscatória de Com. O município tem cinco postos administrativos: Iliomar, Lautém, Lospalos, Luro e Tutuala.
text.en: Lautém covers the eastern end of Timor. Much of it is a limestone plateau raised from the sea, with forests, caves and sinkholes; Lospalos stands on the Fuiloro plateau. Water flows mostly underground, but in the wet season Lake Ira Lalaro, the country's largest lake, spreads across a basin near Lospalos. The coast has white beaches, such as Valu near Tutuala and the fishing village of Com. The municipality has five administrative posts: Iliomar, Lautém, Lospalos, Luro and Tutuala.
text.id: Lautém meliputi ujung timur Timor. Sebagian besar wilayahnya adalah dataran tinggi batu kapur yang terangkat dari laut, dengan hutan, gua, dan lubang runtuhan; Lospalos terletak di dataran tinggi Fuiloro. Air sebagian besar mengalir di bawah tanah, tetapi pada musim hujan Danau Ira Lalaro, danau terbesar di negeri ini, meluas di sebuah cekungan dekat Lospalos. Pesisirnya memiliki pantai putih, seperti Valu dekat Tutuala dan desa nelayan Com. Munisipalitas ini memiliki lima pos administratif: Iliomar, Lautém, Lospalos, Luro, dan Tutuala.

text.tet: Fatuk-kuak sira besik Tutuala rai rastu tuan liu balu husi ema iha rejiaun ne'e. Iha Jerimalai, arkeólogu sira hetan katak ema hela iha ne'ebá liu tinan 40 000 liubá no kaer ikan iha tasi kle'an. Fatuk-kuak nia didin iha fatin hanesan Lene Hara iha pintura tuan sira. Povu Fataluku harii uma aas iha ai-riin nia leten, no fatin lulik sira, hanesan illa Jaku, lisan sei proteje. Família barak kaer metin tradisaun ne'ebé liga ho sira-nia uma-lisan no rai.
text.pt: Grutas e abrigos rochosos perto de Tutuala guardam alguns dos vestígios humanos mais antigos da região. Em Jerimalai, arqueólogos descobriram que já ali viviam pessoas há mais de 40 000 anos, que pescavam em mar aberto. Paredes de grutas em lugares como Lene Hara têm pinturas antigas. O povo fataluku construía casas altas sobre estacas, e lugares sagrados, como a ilha de Jaco, continuam protegidos pelo costume. Muitas famílias mantêm tradições fortes ligadas aos seus clãs e às suas terras.
text.en: Caves and rock shelters near Tutuala hold some of the oldest traces of people in the region. At Jerimalai, archaeologists found that people lived there more than 40,000 years ago and caught fish in the open sea. Cave walls at places such as Lene Hara carry ancient paintings. The Fataluku people built tall houses on posts, and sacred places, such as Jaco Island, are still protected by custom. Many families keep strong traditions linked to their clans and lands.
text.id: Gua dan ceruk batu di dekat Tutuala menyimpan beberapa jejak manusia tertua di kawasan ini. Di Jerimalai, para arkeolog menemukan bahwa manusia sudah tinggal di sana lebih dari 40.000 tahun lalu dan menangkap ikan di laut lepas. Dinding gua di tempat seperti Lene Hara memuat lukisan kuno. Orang Fataluku membangun rumah tinggi di atas tiang, dan tempat-tempat sakral, seperti Pulau Jaco, masih dilindungi adat. Banyak keluarga mempertahankan tradisi kuat yang terkait dengan klan dan tanah mereka.

text.tet: Lautein mak área importante ba rezisténsia. Nino Konis Santana, ne'ebé moris iha Tutuala, lidera FALINTIL iha dékada 1990 nian no mate iha 1998; parke nasionál, ne'ebé harii iha 2007, lori ninia naran. Iha 2022, ema maizumenus 70 000 hela iha Lautein. Barak ko'alia Fataluku; iha Iliomar nia sorin ema ko'alia Makalero, no Makuva, lian ida ho ema uitoan tebes ne'ebé ko'alia, sei moris iha área ki'ik ida. Agrikultór sira kuda hare no batar, hakiak karau no karau-baka iha rai-tetuk, no kaer ikan iha kosta.
text.pt: Lautém foi uma zona importante para a resistência. Nino Konis Santana, nascido em Tutuala, comandou as FALINTIL nos anos 1990 e morreu em 1998; o parque nacional, criado em 2007, tem o seu nome. Cerca de 70 000 pessoas viviam em Lautém em 2022. A maioria fala fataluku; o makalero fala-se à volta de Iliomar, e o makuva, uma língua com muito poucos falantes, sobrevive numa pequena área. Os agricultores cultivam arroz e milho, criam búfalos e gado nos planaltos e pescam ao longo da costa.
text.en: Lautém was an important area for the resistance. Nino Konis Santana, born in Tutuala, led FALINTIL in the 1990s and died in 1998; the national park, created in 2007, carries his name. About 70,000 people lived in Lautém in 2022. Most speak Fataluku; Makalero is spoken around Iliomar, and Makuva, a language with very few speakers, survives in a small area. Farmers grow rice and maize, keep buffalo and cattle on the plateaus, and fish along the coast.
text.id: Lautém adalah daerah penting bagi perlawanan. Nino Konis Santana, yang lahir di Tutuala, memimpin FALINTIL pada 1990-an dan wafat pada 1998; taman nasional yang dibentuk pada 2007 memakai namanya. Sekitar 70.000 orang tinggal di Lautém pada 2022. Sebagian besar berbahasa Fataluku; bahasa Makalero dipakai di sekitar Iliomar, dan Makuva, bahasa dengan sangat sedikit penutur, masih bertahan di daerah kecil. Petani menanam padi dan jagung, memelihara kerbau dan sapi di dataran tinggi, dan menangkap ikan di sepanjang pantai.

text.tet: Parke Nasionál Nino Konis Santana proteje ai-laran, fatuk-kuak, ahu-ruin no illa Jaku. Husi tasi-ibun Valu, peskadór lokál lori vizitante sira hakur ba Jaku ba loron ida. Tutuala iha fatin ida atu haree tasi no illa. Com, iha kosta norte, mak knua peskadór ho tasi-ibun no uma-hospedajen. Lospalos mak vila merkadu no servisu nian, no Lagoa Ira Lalaro dada manu-bee barak. Ema husu ba vizitante sira atu respeita fatin lulik no tuir matadalan lokál.
text.pt: O Parque Nacional Nino Konis Santana protege florestas, grutas, recifes de coral e a ilha de Jaco. A partir da praia de Valu, pescadores locais levam os visitantes a Jaco durante o dia. Tutuala tem um miradouro sobre o mar e a ilha. Com, na costa norte, é uma aldeia piscatória com praias e casas de hóspedes. Lospalos é a vila de mercado e de serviços, e o lago Ira Lalaro atrai muitas aves aquáticas. Pede-se aos visitantes que respeitem os lugares sagrados e sigam os guias locais.
text.en: The Nino Konis Santana National Park protects forests, caves, coral reefs and Jaco Island. From Valu beach, local fishermen take visitors across to Jaco for the day. Tutuala has a viewpoint over the sea and the island. Com, on the north coast, is a fishing village with beaches and guesthouses. Lospalos is the market and service town, and Lake Ira Lalaro attracts many water birds. Visitors are asked to respect sacred places and to follow local guides.
text.id: Taman Nasional Nino Konis Santana melindungi hutan, gua, terumbu karang, dan Pulau Jaco. Dari Pantai Valu, nelayan setempat mengantar pengunjung ke Jaco pada siang hari. Tutuala memiliki tempat pandang ke laut dan pulau itu. Com, di pantai utara, adalah desa nelayan dengan pantai dan penginapan. Lospalos adalah kota pasar dan layanan, dan Danau Ira Lalaro menarik banyak burung air. Pengunjung diminta menghormati tempat-tempat sakral dan mengikuti pemandu lokal.

summary.tet: Likisá iha kosta norte, iha Dili nia loro-monu. Iha ne'e iha forte tuan Maubara, to'os kafé iha ninia foho no portu foun Baía Tibar. Ema barak ko'alia Tokodede ka Mambai.
summary.pt: Liquiçá fica na costa norte, logo a oeste de Díli. Tem o velho forte de Maubara, hortas de café nas colinas e o novo porto da baía de Tibar. Muitas pessoas falam tokodede ou mambai.
summary.en: Liquiçá lies on the north coast just west of Dili. It has the old fort of Maubara, coffee gardens in its hills and the new Tibar Bay port. Many people speak Tokodede or Mambai.
summary.id: Liquiçá terletak di pantai utara, di sebelah barat Dili. Di sini ada benteng tua Maubara, kebun kopi di perbukitannya, dan pelabuhan baru Teluk Tibar. Banyak orang berbahasa Tokodede atau Mambai.

text.tet: Likisá la'o tuir kosta norte iha Dili nia loro-monu, husi baía Tibar to'o mota Lóis iha loro-monu. Rai-tetuk tasi-ibun kloot ida, ho tasi-ibun no knua peskadór sira, iha foho matak sira nia okos, ne'ebé sa'e ba Ermera. Estrada tasi-ibun husi Dili ba fronteira Indonézia nian liu vila Likisá no Maubara. Mota ki'ik sira tun husi foho, no iha tempu udan sira bele nakonu to'o estrada tasi-ibun. Munisípiu ne'e iha postu administrativu tolu: Bazartete, Likisá no Maubara.
text.pt: Liquiçá estende-se ao longo da costa norte, a oeste de Díli, desde a baía de Tibar até à ribeira de Lóis, a oeste. Uma estreita planície costeira, com praias e aldeias de pescadores, fica abaixo de colinas verdes que sobem em direção a Ermera. A estrada costeira de Díli para a fronteira indonésia passa pela vila de Liquiçá e por Maubara. Pequenas ribeiras descem das colinas e, na época das chuvas, podem inundar a estrada costeira. O município tem três postos administrativos: Bazartete, Liquiçá e Maubara.
text.en: Liquiçá stretches along the north coast west of Dili, from Tibar Bay to the Lóis river in the west. A narrow coastal plain with beaches and fishing villages lies below green hills that rise towards Ermera. The coastal road from Dili to the Indonesian border passes through Liquiçá town and Maubara. Small rivers come down from the hills, and in the rainy season they can flood the coastal road. The municipality has three administrative posts: Bazartete, Liquiçá and Maubara.
text.id: Liquiçá membentang di sepanjang pantai utara di barat Dili, dari Teluk Tibar hingga Sungai Lóis di barat. Dataran pantai yang sempit, dengan pantai dan desa nelayan, terletak di bawah perbukitan hijau yang naik ke arah Ermera. Jalan pesisir dari Dili ke perbatasan Indonesia melewati kota Liquiçá dan Maubara. Sungai-sungai kecil turun dari perbukitan, dan pada musim hujan dapat membanjiri jalan pesisir. Munisipalitas ini memiliki tiga pos administratif: Bazartete, Liquiçá, dan Maubara.

text.tet: Maubara mak Olanda nian to'o tratadu 1859, bainhira nia pasa ba Portugál; Olanda harii forte fatuk ida iha ne'ebá iha sékulu 18, ne'ebé sei hamriik iha tasi-ibun. Vila Likisá sei iha edifísiu balu husi tempu Portugés. Iha Abríl 1999, molok konsulta populár, milísia no forsa Indonézia nian ataka ema ne'ebé subar iha Likisá nia igreja, no ema barak mate. Povu Likisá hanoin-hikas vítima sira no hakarak katak ema hotu hatene sira-nia istória.
text.pt: Maubara pertenceu aos holandeses até ao tratado de 1859, quando passou para Portugal; os holandeses tinham construído ali, no século XVIII, um forte de pedra que ainda se ergue junto ao mar. A vila de Liquiçá conserva vários edifícios do tempo português. Em abril de 1999, antes da consulta popular, milícias e forças indonésias atacaram pessoas que se tinham refugiado no recinto da igreja de Liquiçá, e muitas foram mortas. A população de Liquiçá recorda as vítimas e quer que a sua história seja conhecida.
text.en: Maubara was held by the Dutch until the 1859 treaty, when it passed to Portugal; the Dutch had built a stone fort there in the 18th century, which still stands by the sea. Liquiçá town keeps several buildings from Portuguese times. In April 1999, before the popular consultation, militias and Indonesian forces attacked people who had taken refuge in the church compound of Liquiçá, and many were killed. The people of Liquiçá remember the victims and want their story to be known.
text.id: Maubara dikuasai Belanda hingga perjanjian 1859, ketika wilayah itu beralih ke Portugal; Belanda telah membangun benteng batu di sana pada abad ke-18, yang masih berdiri di tepi laut. Kota Liquiçá masih memiliki beberapa bangunan dari masa Portugis. Pada April 1999, sebelum jajak pendapat, milisi dan pasukan Indonesia menyerang orang-orang yang berlindung di kompleks gereja Liquiçá, dan banyak yang tewas. Warga Liquiçá mengenang para korban dan ingin agar kisah mereka diketahui semua orang.

text.tet: Iha 2022, ema maizumenus 84 000 hela iha Likisá. Ema ko'alia Tokodede liuliu iha kosta no Mambai iha foho, no Tetun iha fatin hotu. Família sira kuda kafé iha foho, no nuu, batar no modo besik tasi, no ema barak kaer ikan. Feto sira iha Maubara soru luhu no biti ho kór oin-oin, ne'ebé sira fa'an iha estrada ninin. Desde 2022, Portu Baía Tibar, iha Likisá besik Dili nia rohan, mak nasaun nia portu kontentor prinsipál, ne'ebé lori servisu foun no movimentu barak.
text.pt: Cerca de 84 000 pessoas viviam em Liquiçá em 2022. O tokodede fala-se sobretudo na costa e o mambai nas colinas, e o tétum em todo o lado. As famílias cultivam café nas colinas e coqueiros, milho e legumes perto da costa, e muitas vivem da pesca. As mulheres de Maubara tecem cestos e esteiras coloridos, vendidos à beira da estrada. Desde 2022, o Porto da Baía de Tibar, em Liquiçá, junto ao limite com Díli, é o principal porto de contentores do país, trazendo novos empregos e mais movimento.
text.en: About 84,000 people lived in Liquiçá in 2022. Tokodede is spoken mainly on the coast and Mambai in the hills, with Tetun everywhere. Families grow coffee in the hills and coconuts, maize and vegetables near the coast, and many fish. Women in Maubara weave colourful baskets and mats that are sold along the road. Since 2022 the Tibar Bay Port, in Liquiçá near the edge of Dili, has been the country's main container port, bringing new jobs and much traffic.
text.id: Sekitar 84.000 orang tinggal di Liquiçá pada 2022. Bahasa Tokodede dipakai terutama di pesisir dan Mambai di perbukitan, dengan Tetun di mana-mana. Keluarga menanam kopi di perbukitan serta kelapa, jagung, dan sayuran di dekat pantai, dan banyak yang menangkap ikan. Para perempuan di Maubara menganyam keranjang dan tikar berwarna-warni yang dijual di tepi jalan. Sejak 2022, Pelabuhan Teluk Tibar, di Liquiçá dekat batas dengan Dili, menjadi pelabuhan peti kemas utama negeri ini, membawa lapangan kerja baru dan lalu lintas yang ramai.

text.tet: Forte Maubara, ho ninia didin fatuk mahar iha tasi-ibun, mak fatin ne'ebé ema koñese liu, no ema fa'an luhu iha ninia sorin. Vila Likisá iha edifísiu koloniál no ninia igreja. Tasi-ibun no ahu-ruin iha kosta di'ak atu nani no haree ikan bainhira tasi hakmatek. Bazartete, iha foho, hatudu vista ba kosta no to'os kafé. Viajante sira entre Dili no fronteira dala barak liu fatin hotu ne'e iha estrada tasi-ibun.
text.pt: O forte de Maubara, com as suas grossas muralhas de pedra junto ao mar, é o lugar mais conhecido, e perto vendem-se cestos. A vila de Liquiçá tem edifícios coloniais e a sua igreja. As praias e os recifes de coral da costa são bons para nadar e fazer snorkel com o mar calmo. Bazartete, nas colinas, oferece vistas sobre a costa e as hortas de café. Quem viaja entre Díli e a fronteira passa normalmente por todos estes lugares na estrada costeira.
text.en: The fort of Maubara, with its thick stone walls by the sea, is the best-known sight, and baskets are sold nearby. Liquiçá town has colonial buildings and its church. Beaches and coral reefs along the coast are good for swimming and snorkelling when the sea is calm. Bazartete, in the hills, offers views over the coast and coffee gardens. Travellers between Dili and the border usually pass through all these places on the coastal road.
text.id: Benteng Maubara, dengan tembok batunya yang tebal di tepi laut, adalah tempat yang paling terkenal, dan keranjang dijual di dekatnya. Kota Liquiçá memiliki bangunan kolonial dan gerejanya. Pantai dan terumbu karang di sepanjang pesisir cocok untuk berenang dan snorkeling saat laut tenang. Bazartete, di perbukitan, menawarkan pemandangan ke pesisir dan kebun kopi. Pelancong antara Dili dan perbatasan biasanya melewati semua tempat ini di jalan pesisir.

heading.tet: Husi kosta ida ba kosta seluk

text.tet: Manatutu mak munisípiu balu ne'ebé to'o tasi rua. Iha norte, vila Manatutu iha kosta maran ida iha estrada husi Dili ba Baukau, besik mota Laclo nia ibun; Laclo mak mota naruk liu balu iha Timór-Leste. Iha rai-laran, rai sa'e to'o foho Laclubar no Soibada nian, no iha sul nia loke ba rai-tetuk luan Natarbora iha Tasi Timór. Munisípiu ne'e iha postu administrativu neen: Barique (Natarbora), Laclo, Laclubar, Laleia, Manatutu no Soibada.
text.pt: Manatuto é um dos poucos municípios que tocam os dois mares. A norte, a vila de Manatuto fica numa costa seca, na estrada de Díli para Baucau, perto da foz do Laclo, um dos rios mais longos de Timor-Leste. Para o interior, o terreno sobe até às montanhas de Laclubar e Soibada e, a sul, abre-se na larga planície de Natarbora, junto ao mar de Timor. O município tem seis postos administrativos: Barique (Natarbora), Laclo, Laclubar, Laleia, Manatuto e Soibada.
text.en: Manatuto is one of the few municipalities that touch both seas. In the north, the town of Manatuto lies on a dry coast on the road from Dili to Baucau, near the mouth of the Laclo, one of the longest rivers of Timor-Leste. Inland, the land rises to the mountains of Laclubar and Soibada, and in the south it opens into the wide plain of Natarbora on the Timor Sea. The municipality has six administrative posts: Barique (Natarbora), Laclo, Laclubar, Laleia, Manatuto and Soibada.
text.id: Manatuto adalah salah satu dari sedikit munisipalitas yang menyentuh kedua laut. Di utara, kota Manatuto terletak di pantai yang kering di jalan dari Dili ke Baucau, dekat muara Sungai Laclo, salah satu sungai terpanjang di Timor-Leste. Ke pedalaman, daratan naik hingga pegunungan Laclubar dan Soibada, dan di selatan terbuka menjadi dataran luas Natarbora di tepi Laut Timor. Munisipalitas ini memiliki enam pos administratif: Barique (Natarbora), Laclo, Laclubar, Laleia, Manatuto, dan Soibada.

text.tet: Soibada, iha foho, iha tradisaun Katólika naruk: ninia koléjiu misaun istóriku eduka timoroan barak durante tempu koloniál, no santuáriu Maria nian iha Aitara dada peregrinu sira. Nicolau Lobato, Primeiru-Ministru iha 1975 no asuwa'in nasionál, moris iha Soibada iha 1946. Xanana Gusmão, lider rezisténsia, Prezidente dahuluk repúblika restaurada nian no depois Primeiru-Ministru, moris iha Laleia, besik kosta norte, mós iha 1946. Igreja tuan Laleia nian mak fatin ida ne'ebé ema haree iha estrada ba loro-sa'e.
text.pt: Soibada, nas montanhas, tem uma longa tradição católica: o seu histórico colégio da missão educou muitos timorenses no período colonial, e o santuário mariano de Aitara atrai peregrinos. Nicolau Lobato, primeiro-ministro em 1975 e herói nacional, nasceu em Soibada em 1946. Xanana Gusmão, líder da resistência, primeiro Presidente da república restaurada e mais tarde primeiro-ministro, nasceu em Laleia, perto da costa norte, também em 1946. A velha igreja de Laleia é um marco na estrada para leste.
text.en: Soibada, in the mountains, has a long Catholic tradition: its historic mission college educated many Timorese in colonial times, and the Marian shrine of Aitara draws pilgrims. Nicolau Lobato, Prime Minister in 1975 and a national hero, was born in Soibada in 1946. Xanana Gusmão, leader of the resistance, first President of the restored republic and later Prime Minister, was born in Laleia, near the north coast, also in 1946. Laleia's old church is a landmark on the road east.
text.id: Soibada, di pegunungan, memiliki tradisi Katolik yang panjang: kolese misinya yang bersejarah mendidik banyak orang Timor pada masa kolonial, dan tempat ziarah Maria di Aitara menarik para peziarah. Nicolau Lobato, perdana menteri pada 1975 dan pahlawan nasional, lahir di Soibada pada 1946. Xanana Gusmão, pemimpin perlawanan, presiden pertama republik yang dipulihkan dan kemudian perdana menteri, lahir di Laleia, dekat pantai utara, juga pada 1946. Gereja tua Laleia menjadi penanda di jalan menuju timur.

text.tet: Iha 2022, ema maizumenus 51 000 hela iha Manatutu, tan ne'e nia mak munisípiu ida ho ema menus liu balu. Ema ko'alia Galoli iha kosta norte, Idaté no lian seluk ne'ebé besik iha foho Laclubar nian, no Tetun Terik iha kosta sul iha Natarbora. Agrikultór sira kuda hare iha rai-tetuk Natarbora no iha mota Laclo nia ninin, no mós batar, no hakiak karau-baka no karau. Kaer ikan importante iha kosta rua. Família barak mós hakiak fahi no bibi.
text.pt: Cerca de 51 000 pessoas viviam em Manatuto em 2022, o que faz dele um dos municípios menos povoados. Fala-se galoli na costa norte, idaté e línguas aparentadas nas montanhas à volta de Laclubar, e tétum terik na costa sul, em Natarbora. Os agricultores cultivam arroz na planície de Natarbora e ao longo do Laclo, além de milho, e criam gado bovino e búfalos. A pesca é importante nas duas costas. Muitas famílias criam também porcos e cabras.
text.en: About 51,000 people lived in Manatuto in 2022, making it one of the less populated municipalities. Galoli is spoken on the north coast, Idaté and related languages in the mountains around Laclubar, and Tetun Terik on the south coast at Natarbora. Farmers grow rice on the Natarbora plain and along the Laclo, as well as maize, and raise cattle and buffalo. Fishing is important on both coasts. Many families also keep pigs and goats.
text.id: Sekitar 51.000 orang tinggal di Manatuto pada 2022, sehingga termasuk munisipalitas yang paling sedikit penduduknya. Bahasa Galoli dipakai di pantai utara, Idaté dan bahasa-bahasa yang berkerabat di pegunungan sekitar Laclubar, dan Tetun Terik di pantai selatan di Natarbora. Petani menanam padi di dataran Natarbora dan di sepanjang Sungai Laclo, juga jagung, serta memelihara sapi dan kerbau. Perikanan penting di kedua pantai. Banyak keluarga juga memelihara babi dan kambing.

text.tet: Vila Manatutu, iha estrada tasi-ibun, mak fatin ne'ebé ema dala barak para entre Dili no Baukau. Laleia iha ninia igreja tuan iha estrada ninin. Soibada, ho ninia koléjiu istóriku no santuáriu Aitara, mak fatin peregrinasaun nian. Laclubar, aas iha foho, iha anin malirin no vista luan. Iha sul, Natarbora iha natar no tasi-ibun naruk no hakmatek iha Tasi Timór. Estrada sira iha foho liga kosta rua, maski iha tempu udan dalan bele susar.
text.pt: A vila de Manatuto, na estrada costeira, é uma paragem habitual entre Díli e Baucau. Laleia tem a sua velha igreja à beira da estrada. Soibada, com o seu colégio histórico e o santuário de Aitara, é lugar de peregrinação. Laclubar, no alto das montanhas, oferece ar fresco e vistas largas. A sul, Natarbora tem arrozais e praias longas e tranquilas no mar de Timor. Estradas de montanha ligam as duas costas, embora possam ser difíceis na época das chuvas.
text.en: Manatuto town, on the coastal road, is a common stop between Dili and Baucau. Laleia has its old church by the road. Soibada, with its historic college and the Aitara shrine, is a place of pilgrimage. Laclubar, high in the mountains, offers cool air and wide views. In the south, Natarbora has rice fields and long, quiet beaches on the Timor Sea. Mountain roads link the two coasts, although they can be difficult in the rainy season.
text.id: Kota Manatuto, di jalan pesisir, adalah tempat singgah yang umum antara Dili dan Baucau. Laleia memiliki gereja tua di tepi jalan. Soibada, dengan kolese bersejarah dan tempat ziarah Aitara, adalah tempat peziarahan. Laclubar, tinggi di pegunungan, menawarkan udara sejuk dan pemandangan luas. Di selatan, Natarbora memiliki sawah serta pantai panjang yang tenang di Laut Timor. Jalan-jalan pegunungan menghubungkan kedua pantai, meskipun bisa sulit dilalui pada musim hujan.

summary.tet: Manufahi, ho ninia kapitál Same, la'o husi foho Kablaki to'o kosta sul iha Betano. Ema hanoin nia tanba revolta boot ne'ebé Dom Boaventura lidera iha 1911–1912 hasoru ukun Portugés.
summary.pt: Manufahi, com capital em Same, vai das montanhas do Kablaki até à costa sul, em Betano. É recordado pela grande revolta liderada por D. Boaventura em 1911–1912 contra o domínio português.
summary.en: Manufahi, with its capital Same, runs from the Kablaki mountains to the south coast at Betano. It is remembered for the great revolt led by Dom Boaventura in 1911–1912 against Portuguese rule.
summary.id: Manufahi, dengan ibu kota Same, membentang dari Pegunungan Kablaki hingga pantai selatan di Betano. Daerah ini dikenang karena pemberontakan besar yang dipimpin Dom Boaventura pada 1911–1912 melawan kekuasaan Portugis.

text.tet: Manufahi sa'e iha norte to'o Foho Kablaki, foho aas liu balu iha nasaun, no tun ba sul to'o rai-tetuk no tasi-ibun iha Tasi Timór. Same, kapitál, iha rai-kuak matak ida iha foho sira nia okos, ho klima malirin liu kosta. Betano, iha kosta sul, iha tasi-ibun naruk ida no sentrál eletrisidade ida ne'ebé fó eletrisidade ba rede nasionál. Munisípiu ne'e iha postu administrativu haat: Alas, Fatuberliu, Same no Turiscai.
text.pt: Manufahi sobe a norte até ao monte Kablaki, uma das montanhas mais altas do país, e desce a sul até planícies e praias no mar de Timor. Same, a capital, fica num vale verde abaixo das montanhas, com clima mais fresco do que o litoral. Betano, na costa sul, tem uma longa praia e uma central elétrica que abastece a rede nacional. O município tem quatro postos administrativos: Alas, Fatuberliu, Same e Turiscai.
text.en: Manufahi rises in the north to Mount Kablaki, one of the highest mountains of the country, and falls to plains and beaches on the Timor Sea in the south. Same, the capital, lies in a green valley below the mountains, with a cooler climate than the coast. Betano, on the south coast, has a long beach and a power station that supplies the national grid. The municipality has four administrative posts: Alas, Fatuberliu, Same and Turiscai.
text.id: Manufahi naik di utara hingga Gunung Kablaki, salah satu gunung tertinggi di negeri ini, dan menurun ke selatan hingga dataran dan pantai di Laut Timor. Same, ibu kotanya, terletak di lembah hijau di bawah pegunungan, dengan iklim lebih sejuk daripada di pesisir. Betano, di pantai selatan, memiliki pantai panjang dan pembangkit listrik yang memasok jaringan nasional. Munisipalitas ini memiliki empat pos administratif: Alas, Fatuberliu, Same, dan Turiscai.

text.tet: Iha 1911, Dom Boaventura, liurai Manufahi nian, lidera revolta boot ida hasoru ukun Portugés, impostu ulun nian no servisu forsadu. Reinu seluk tama hamutuk, no funu namkari ba rai ne'e nia parte barak. Portugál lori tropa no ró-funu, no iha 1912 Portugál manán; timoroan rihun ba rihun mate ka sai prezu. Ohin loron ema fó onra ba Dom Boaventura hanesan asuwa'in nasionál, no ema hanoin revolta ne'e hanesan asaun rezisténsia boot ida molok luta ba independénsia iha sékulu 20.
text.pt: Em 1911, D. Boaventura, liurai de Manufahi, liderou uma grande revolta contra o domínio português, o imposto de capitação e o trabalho forçado. Outros reinos juntaram-se, e os combates espalharam-se por grande parte do território. Portugal trouxe tropas e navios de guerra e, em 1912, a revolta foi esmagada; milhares de timorenses foram mortos ou capturados. D. Boaventura é hoje honrado como herói nacional, e a revolta é lembrada como um dos grandes atos de resistência antes da luta pela independência no século XX.
text.en: In 1911 Dom Boaventura, the liurai of Manufahi, led a great uprising against Portuguese rule, the head tax and forced labour. Other kingdoms joined, and fighting spread across much of the territory. Portugal brought in troops and warships, and in 1912 the revolt was crushed; thousands of Timorese were killed or captured. Dom Boaventura is honoured today as a national hero, and the revolt is remembered as one of the great acts of resistance before the twentieth-century struggle for independence.
text.id: Pada 1911 Dom Boaventura, liurai Manufahi, memimpin pemberontakan besar melawan kekuasaan Portugis, pajak kepala, dan kerja paksa. Kerajaan-kerajaan lain ikut bergabung, dan pertempuran menyebar ke sebagian besar wilayah. Portugal mendatangkan pasukan dan kapal perang, dan pada 1912 pemberontakan itu ditumpas; ribuan orang Timor tewas atau ditawan. Kini Dom Boaventura dihormati sebagai pahlawan nasional, dan pemberontakan itu dikenang sebagai salah satu aksi perlawanan besar sebelum perjuangan kemerdekaan abad ke-20.

text.tet: Iha 2022, ema maizumenus 60 500 hela iha Manufahi. Ema ko'alia Mambai iha Same no Turiscai nia sorin, no Tetun Terik iha kosta sul iha Alas no Fatuberliu nia sorin. Kafé moris iha foho sira iha Same no Turiscai nia sorin, no hare, batar no karau-baka importante iha rai-tetuk sul; kaer ikan importante iha Betano. Francisco Xavier do Amaral, Prezidente dahuluk Repúblika Demokrátika Timór-Leste ne'ebé proklama iha 1975, moris iha Turiscai iha 1937.
text.pt: Cerca de 60 500 pessoas viviam em Manufahi em 2022. O mambai fala-se à volta de Same e Turiscai, e o tétum terik na costa sul, à volta de Alas e Fatuberliu. O café cresce nas colinas à volta de Same e Turiscai, enquanto o arroz, o milho e o gado são importantes nas planícies do sul; a pesca é importante em Betano. Francisco Xavier do Amaral, primeiro Presidente da República Democrática de Timor-Leste proclamada em 1975, nasceu em Turiscai em 1937.
text.en: About 60,500 people lived in Manufahi in 2022. Mambai is spoken around Same and Turiscai, and Tetun Terik on the south coast around Alas and Fatuberliu. Coffee grows in the hills around Same and Turiscai, while rice, maize and cattle are important on the southern plains; fishing is important at Betano. Francisco Xavier do Amaral, the first President of the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste proclaimed in 1975, was born in Turiscai in 1937.
text.id: Sekitar 60.500 orang tinggal di Manufahi pada 2022. Bahasa Mambai dipakai di sekitar Same dan Turiscai, dan Tetun Terik di pantai selatan sekitar Alas dan Fatuberliu. Kopi tumbuh di perbukitan sekitar Same dan Turiscai, sedangkan padi, jagung, dan sapi penting di dataran selatan; perikanan penting di Betano. Francisco Xavier do Amaral, presiden pertama Republik Demokratik Timor-Leste yang diproklamasikan pada 1975, lahir di Turiscai pada 1937.

text.tet: Same mak vila foho ida ne'ebé kmanek, ho edifísiu koloniál, merkadu no vista ba Kablaki, no ema sai husi ne'e atu la'o sa'e foho. Betano iha tasi-ibun luan ida iha Tasi Timór. Ema to'o Turiscai no Fatuberliu liu estrada foho iha to'os kafé no ai-laran sira nia leet. Same kaer metin memória Dom Boaventura no revolta 1912 nian. Estrada husi Same ba Betano liga foho aas ho kosta sul. Kalan iha Same malirin, tan ne'e vizitante sira tenke lori roupa manas.
text.pt: Same é uma agradável vila de montanha, com edifícios coloniais, um mercado e vista para o Kablaki, e é o ponto de partida para subidas à montanha. Betano tem uma praia larga no mar de Timor. Chega-se a Turiscai e a Fatuberliu por estradas de montanha entre hortas de café e florestas. Same guarda a memória de D. Boaventura e da revolta de 1912. A estrada de Same para Betano liga as terras altas à costa sul. As noites em Same são frescas, por isso os visitantes devem levar roupa quente.
text.en: Same is a pleasant mountain town with colonial buildings, a market and views of Kablaki, and it is the starting point for walks up the mountain. Betano has a wide beach on the Timor Sea. Turiscai and Fatuberliu are reached by mountain roads through coffee gardens and forests. Same keeps the memory of Dom Boaventura and the revolt of 1912. The road from Same to Betano links the highlands with the south coast. Evenings in Same are cool, so visitors should bring warm clothes.
text.id: Same adalah kota pegunungan yang menyenangkan dengan bangunan kolonial, pasar, dan pemandangan Kablaki, serta menjadi titik awal pendakian ke gunung itu. Betano memiliki pantai yang luas di Laut Timor. Turiscai dan Fatuberliu dicapai melalui jalan pegunungan di antara kebun kopi dan hutan. Same menjaga kenangan tentang Dom Boaventura dan pemberontakan 1912. Jalan dari Same ke Betano menghubungkan dataran tinggi dengan pantai selatan. Malam di Same terasa sejuk, jadi pengunjung sebaiknya membawa pakaian hangat.

summary.tet: Oe-Kusi Ambenu, iha rai, Indonézia nia Timór loro-monu haleu nia, no nia hasoru Tasi Savu. Iha ne'e, iha Lifau, Portugés hela dahuluk iha Timór. Desde 2014, nia mak Rejiaun Administrativa Espesiál (RAEOA), ho Pante Makasar hanesan kapitál.
summary.pt: Oé-Cusse Ambeno está rodeado por terra pelo Timor Ocidental indonésio e virado para o mar de Savu. Foi aqui, em Lifau, que os portugueses se fixaram pela primeira vez em Timor. Desde 2014 é uma Região Administrativa Especial (RAEOA), com capital em Pante Macassar.
summary.en: Oé-Cusse Ambeno is surrounded on land by Indonesian West Timor and faces the Savu Sea. Here, at Lifau, the Portuguese first settled in Timor. Since 2014 it has been a Special Administrative Region (RAEOA), with Pante Macassar as its capital.
summary.id: Oé-Cusse Ambeno di darat dikelilingi Timor Barat, Indonesia, dan menghadap Laut Sawu. Di sinilah, di Lifau, orang Portugis pertama kali menetap di Timor. Sejak 2014 wilayah ini menjadi Wilayah Administratif Khusus (RAEOA), dengan ibu kota Pante Macassar.

text.tet: Oe-Kusi Ambenu iha Timór nia parte loro-monu nia kosta norte, no ninia luan maizumenus km² 815. Iha rai, Indonézia nia provínsia Nusa Tenggara Timur haleu nia; ninia sorin norte hasoru Tasi Savu. Foho sira sa'e iha rai-tetuk tasi-ibun kloot ida nia kotuk, no mota Tono fó bee ba rai-tetuk besik Pante Makasar. Rejiaun ne'e iha postu administrativu haat: Nitibe, Oesilo, Pante Makasar no Passabe. Atu ba Dili, ema uza ró-ahi, aviaun ka estrada liu Indonézia.
text.pt: Oé-Cusse Ambeno fica na costa norte da metade ocidental de Timor e tem cerca de 815 km². Por terra está rodeado pela província indonésia de Nusa Tenggara Oriental; o lado norte dá para o mar de Savu. Montanhas erguem-se por trás de uma estreita planície costeira, e a ribeira de Tono rega a planície perto de Pante Macassar. A região tem quatro postos administrativos: Nitibe, Oesilo, Pante Macassar e Passabe. Para ir a Díli usa-se o ferry, o avião ou a estrada através da Indonésia.
text.en: Oé-Cusse Ambeno lies on the north coast of the western half of Timor and covers about 815 km². On land it is surrounded by the Indonesian province of East Nusa Tenggara; its northern side faces the Savu Sea. Mountains rise behind a narrow coastal plain, and the Tono river waters the plain near Pante Macassar. The region has four administrative posts: Nitibe, Oesilo, Pante Macassar and Passabe. Travel to Dili is by ferry, by plane or by road through Indonesia.
text.id: Oé-Cusse Ambeno terletak di pantai utara bagian barat Pulau Timor dan luasnya sekitar 815 km². Di darat wilayah ini dikelilingi Provinsi Nusa Tenggara Timur, Indonesia; sisi utaranya menghadap Laut Sawu. Pegunungan menjulang di belakang dataran pantai yang sempit, dan Sungai Tono mengairi dataran dekat Pante Macassar. Wilayah ini memiliki empat pos administratif: Nitibe, Oesilo, Pante Macassar, dan Passabe. Perjalanan ke Dili ditempuh dengan kapal feri, pesawat, atau jalan darat melalui Indonesia.

text.tet: Ró Portugés to'o Lifau, iha kosta ne'e, maizumenus iha 1515, no depois frade dominikanu no komersiante sira hela iha ne'ebá. Lifau sai fatin dahuluk ne'ebé Portugés hela no Timór Portugés nia kapitál to'o 1769, bainhira kapitál muda ba Dili. Topasses sira, grupu ida ho raan kahur ne'ebé ko'alia Portugés, iha podér boot iha rejiaun ne'e durante tempu naruk. Bainhira Portugál no Olanda fahe Timór, Oe-Kusi hela nafatin ho Portugál. Iha 1999, rejiaun ne'e terus ho violénsia hafoin konsulta populár, no ema barak halai.
text.pt: Navios portugueses chegaram a Lifau, nesta costa, por volta de 1515, e mais tarde ali se fixaram frades dominicanos e comerciantes. Lifau tornou-se o primeiro povoado português e a capital do Timor Português até 1769, quando a capital passou para Díli. Os topasses, um grupo mestiço de língua portuguesa, foram poderosos na região durante muito tempo. Quando Portugal e os Países Baixos dividiram Timor, Oé-Cusse continuou português. Em 1999, a região sofreu violência depois da consulta popular, e muitas pessoas fugiram.
text.en: Portuguese ships reached Lifau, on this coast, around 1515, and later Dominican friars and traders settled there. Lifau became the first Portuguese settlement and the capital of Portuguese Timor until 1769, when the capital moved to Dili. The Topasses, a mixed Portuguese-speaking group, were powerful in the region for a long time. When Portugal and the Netherlands divided Timor, Oé-Cusse stayed Portuguese. In 1999 the region suffered violence after the popular consultation, and many people fled.
text.id: Kapal Portugis tiba di Lifau, di pantai ini, sekitar tahun 1515, dan kemudian para biarawan Dominikan serta pedagang menetap di sana. Lifau menjadi permukiman Portugis pertama dan ibu kota Timor Portugis hingga 1769, ketika ibu kota pindah ke Dili. Kaum Topasses, kelompok campuran yang berbahasa Portugis, lama berkuasa di wilayah ini. Ketika Portugal dan Belanda membagi Timor, Oé-Cusse tetap milik Portugis. Pada 1999 wilayah ini mengalami kekerasan setelah jajak pendapat, dan banyak orang mengungsi.

text.tet: Konstituisaun fó polítika administrativa no rejime ekonómiku espesiál ba Oe-Kusi Ambenu. Iha 2014, lei ida harii Rejiaun Administrativa Espesiál Oe-Kusi Ambenu (RAEOA), ho ninia Autoridade rasik, no Zona Espesiál Ekonomia Sosiál Merkadu nian (ZEESM) atu dada investimentu. Desde ne'ebá, sira harii estrada, ponte, sentrál eletrisidade no aeroportu, maski ema diskute oinsá fahe benefísiu sira. Iha 2022, ema maizumenus 80 700 hela iha rejiaun ne'e. Barak ko'alia Baikenu, variante ida husi lian Uab Meto ne'ebé ema mós ko'alia iha Timór loro-monu.
text.pt: A Constituição dá a Oé-Cusse Ambeno uma política administrativa e um regime económico especiais. Em 2014, uma lei criou a Região Administrativa Especial de Oé-Cusse Ambeno (RAEOA), dirigida por uma Autoridade própria, e uma Zona Especial de Economia Social de Mercado (ZEESM) para atrair investimento. Desde então construíram-se estradas, uma ponte, uma central elétrica e um aeroporto, embora se tenha discutido como partilhar os benefícios. Cerca de 80 700 pessoas viviam na região em 2022. A maioria fala baikeno, uma variedade da língua uab meto, também falada em Timor Ocidental.
text.en: The Constitution gives Oé-Cusse Ambeno a special administrative policy and economic regime. In 2014 a law created the Special Administrative Region of Oé-Cusse Ambeno (RAEOA), led by its own Authority, and a Special Zone of Social Market Economy (ZEESM) to attract investment. Since then roads, a bridge, a power station and an airport have been built, although people have debated how the benefits should be shared. About 80,700 people lived in the region in 2022. Most speak Baikeno, a variety of the Uab Meto language that is also spoken in West Timor.
text.id: Konstitusi memberi Oé-Cusse Ambeno kebijakan administratif dan rezim ekonomi khusus. Pada 2014 sebuah undang-undang membentuk Wilayah Administratif Khusus Oé-Cusse Ambeno (RAEOA), yang dipimpin Otoritas sendiri, dan Zona Khusus Ekonomi Pasar Sosial (ZEESM) untuk menarik investasi. Sejak itu dibangun jalan, jembatan, pembangkit listrik, dan bandara, meskipun orang memperdebatkan cara membagi manfaatnya. Sekitar 80.700 orang tinggal di wilayah ini pada 2022. Sebagian besar berbahasa Baikeno, ragam bahasa Uab Meto yang juga dipakai di Timor Barat.

text.tet: Pante Makasar, kapitál, iha tasi-ibun nia naruk ho merkadu, igreja no edifísiu públiku foun sira. Monumentu ida iha Lifau, iha vila nia loro-monu, marka fatin ne'ebé Portugés to'o dahuluk; ema selebra tinan 500 iha 2015. Iha foho sira, Oesilo no Passabe besik fronteira, no Nitibe iha loro-monu. Kosta iha tasi-ibun naruk no tasi hakmatek iha tempu bailoron. Ró-ahi no aviaun ki'ik liga rejiaun ne'e ho Dili.
text.pt: Pante Macassar, a capital, estende-se ao longo da praia, com mercados, igrejas e novos edifícios públicos. Um monumento em Lifau, a oeste da vila, marca o lugar onde os portugueses chegaram pela primeira vez; os 500 anos foram celebrados em 2015. Nas colinas, Oesilo e Passabe ficam perto da fronteira, e Nitibe fica a oeste. A costa tem praias longas e mar calmo na época seca. Ferries e pequenos aviões ligam a região a Díli.
text.en: Pante Macassar, the capital, stretches along the beach, with markets, churches and new public buildings. A monument at Lifau, west of the town, marks the place where the Portuguese first arrived; the 500th anniversary was celebrated in 2015. In the hills, Oesilo and Passabe are close to the border, and Nitibe lies in the west. The coast has long beaches and calm water in the dry season. Ferries and small planes link the region with Dili.
text.id: Pante Macassar, ibu kotanya, membentang di sepanjang pantai dengan pasar, gereja, dan gedung-gedung publik baru. Sebuah monumen di Lifau, di sebelah barat kota, menandai tempat orang Portugis pertama kali tiba; peringatan 500 tahun dirayakan pada 2015. Di perbukitan, Oesilo dan Passabe dekat dengan perbatasan, dan Nitibe terletak di barat. Pesisirnya memiliki pantai panjang dan laut yang tenang pada musim kemarau. Kapal feri dan pesawat kecil menghubungkan wilayah ini dengan Dili.

summary.tet: Vikeke iha kosta sul, entre foho sira iha klaran no Tasi Timór. Rai-tetuk iha Uato-Lari no Uatucarbau nia sorin mak fatin hare nian prinsipál balu iha nasaun. Ema hanoin nia tanba revolta 1959 hasoru ukun Portugés.
summary.pt: Viqueque fica na costa sul, entre as montanhas do centro e o mar de Timor. As planícies à volta de Uato-Lari e Uatucarbau estão entre as principais zonas de arroz do país. É lembrado pela revolta de 1959 contra o domínio português.
summary.en: Viqueque lies on the south coast, between the central mountains and the Timor Sea. The plains around Uato-Lari and Uatucarbau are among the country's main rice areas. It is remembered for the 1959 revolt against Portuguese rule.
summary.id: Viqueque terletak di pantai selatan, di antara pegunungan tengah dan Laut Timor. Dataran di sekitar Uato-Lari dan Uatucarbau termasuk daerah padi utama di negeri ini. Viqueque dikenang karena pemberontakan 1959 melawan kekuasaan Portugis.

text.tet: Vikeke la'o husi foho sira iha Ossu nia sorin to'o rai-tetuk luan no tasi-ibun naruk iha Tasi Timór. Mota sira suli ba sul liu rai-tetuk, no ema uza sira atu fó bee ba natar, liuliu iha Uato-Lari no Uatucarbau. Kosta sul iha tempu udan naruk, no inundasaun bele kotu estrada. Beaço, iha kosta, iha planu hanesan parte husi projetu petróleu Tasi Mane. Munisípiu ne'e iha postu administrativu lima: Lacluta, Ossu, Uato-Lari, Uatucarbau no Vikeke.
text.pt: Viqueque vai das montanhas à volta de Ossu até largas planícies e longas praias no mar de Timor. Os rios correm para sul através das planícies e são usados para regar arrozais, sobretudo em Uato-Lari e Uatucarbau. A costa sul tem uma longa época das chuvas, e as cheias podem cortar estradas. Beaço, no litoral, está prevista como parte do projeto petrolífero Tasi Mane. O município tem cinco postos administrativos: Lacluta, Ossu, Uato-Lari, Uatucarbau e Viqueque.
text.en: Viqueque reaches from the mountains around Ossu down to wide plains and long beaches on the Timor Sea. Rivers flow south across the plains and are used to irrigate rice fields, especially in Uato-Lari and Uatucarbau. The south coast has a long rainy season, and floods can cut roads. Beaço, on the coast, is planned as part of the Tasi Mane petroleum project. The municipality has five administrative posts: Lacluta, Ossu, Uato-Lari, Uatucarbau and Viqueque.
text.id: Viqueque membentang dari pegunungan di sekitar Ossu hingga dataran luas dan pantai panjang di Laut Timor. Sungai-sungai mengalir ke selatan melintasi dataran dan dipakai untuk mengairi sawah, terutama di Uato-Lari dan Uatucarbau. Pantai selatan memiliki musim hujan yang panjang, dan banjir dapat memutus jalan. Beaço, di pesisir, direncanakan menjadi bagian proyek perminyakan Tasi Mane. Munisipalitas ini memiliki lima pos administratif: Lacluta, Ossu, Uato-Lari, Uatucarbau, dan Viqueque.

text.tet: Iha Juñu 1959, povu iha Vikeke, liuliu iha Uato-Lari no Uatucarbau nia sorin, hamriik hasoru ukun koloniál Portugés. Portugál hapara revolta ne'e lalais no ho violénsia, no ema barak mate ka sira haruka ba ezíliu. Durante okupasaun Indonézia, iha 1983, tropa Indonézia oho ema barak husi knua Kraras, besik vila Vikeke, hafoin atake ida husi funu-na'in timoroan; Kraras sai famozu hanesan 'knua faluk sira nian'. Ema iha munisípiu ne'e hanoin-hikas eventu sira-ne'e ho respeitu.
text.pt: Em junho de 1959, a população de Viqueque, sobretudo à volta de Uato-Lari e Uatucarbau, revoltou-se contra o domínio colonial português. A revolta foi reprimida depressa e com dureza, e muitas pessoas foram mortas ou deportadas. Durante a ocupação indonésia, em 1983, tropas indonésias mataram muitas pessoas da aldeia de Kraras, perto da vila de Viqueque, depois de um ataque de combatentes timorenses; Kraras ficou conhecida como a 'aldeia das viúvas'. Estes acontecimentos são recordados com respeito no município.
text.en: In June 1959 people in Viqueque, especially around Uato-Lari and Uatucarbau, rose against Portuguese colonial rule. The revolt was put down quickly and harshly, and many people were killed or sent into exile. During the Indonesian occupation, in 1983, Indonesian troops killed many people from the village of Kraras, near Viqueque town, after an attack by Timorese fighters; Kraras became known as the 'village of widows'. These events are remembered with respect in the municipality.
text.id: Pada Juni 1959, rakyat di Viqueque, terutama di sekitar Uato-Lari dan Uatucarbau, bangkit melawan kekuasaan kolonial Portugis. Pemberontakan itu ditumpas dengan cepat dan keras, dan banyak orang dibunuh atau dibuang. Selama pendudukan Indonesia, pada 1983, pasukan Indonesia membunuh banyak warga desa Kraras, dekat kota Viqueque, setelah serangan oleh pejuang Timor; Kraras kemudian dikenal sebagai 'desa para janda'. Peristiwa-peristiwa ini dikenang dengan hormat di munisipalitas ini.

text.tet: Iha 2022, ema maizumenus 80 000 hela iha Vikeke. Ema ko'alia Tetun Terik iha vila Vikeke nia sorin no iha kosta, Makasae iha Ossu nia sorin, Naueti iha Uato-Lari no Uatucarbau nia parte balu, no Kairui-Midiki iha área seluk. Família barak halo to'os: hare iha rai-tetuk ho irigasaun, batar no ai-farina iha foho, no karau no karau-baka iha du'ut-laran. Nuu no ikan mai husi kosta. Francisco Guterres 'Lú-Olo', Prezidente Repúblika husi 2017 to'o 2022, moris iha Ossu iha 1954.
text.pt: Cerca de 80 000 pessoas viviam em Viqueque em 2022. Fala-se tétum terik à volta da vila de Viqueque e na costa, makasae à volta de Ossu, naueti em partes de Uato-Lari e Uatucarbau, e kairui-midiki noutras zonas. A maioria das famílias vive da agricultura: arroz nas planícies irrigadas, milho e mandioca nas colinas, e búfalos e gado nos pastos. O coco e o peixe vêm da costa. Francisco Guterres 'Lú-Olo', Presidente da República de 2017 a 2022, nasceu em Ossu em 1954.
text.en: About 80,000 people lived in Viqueque in 2022. Tetun Terik is spoken around Viqueque town and on the coast, Makasae around Ossu, Naueti in parts of Uato-Lari and Uatucarbau, and Kairui-Midiki in other areas. Most families farm: rice on the irrigated plains, maize and cassava in the hills, and buffalo and cattle on the grasslands. Coconuts and fish come from the coast. Francisco Guterres 'Lú-Olo', President of the Republic from 2017 to 2022, was born in Ossu in 1954.
text.id: Sekitar 80.000 orang tinggal di Viqueque pada 2022. Bahasa Tetun Terik dipakai di sekitar kota Viqueque dan di pesisir, Makasae di sekitar Ossu, Naueti di sebagian Uato-Lari dan Uatucarbau, dan Kairui-Midiki di daerah lain. Sebagian besar keluarga bertani: padi di dataran beririgasi, jagung dan singkong di perbukitan, serta kerbau dan sapi di padang rumput. Kelapa dan ikan berasal dari pesisir. Francisco Guterres 'Lú-Olo', Presiden Republik dari 2017 sampai 2022, lahir di Ossu pada 1954.

text.tet: Vila Vikeke, iha rai-laran besik kosta, mak sentru merkadu no servisu nian, ho edifísiu husi tempu koloniál. Ossu, iha foho, iha klima malirin no vista ba foho Mundo Perdido. Natar iha Uato-Lari no Uatucarbau matak hafoin udan. Beaço no tasi-ibun seluk iha Tasi Timór naruk no hakmatek, maibé laloran no bee-suli makaas, tan ne'e ema ne'ebé nani tenke kuidadu. Viajante barak to'o Vikeke liu estrada husi Baukau, liu Venilale no Ossu.
text.pt: A vila de Viqueque, um pouco para o interior, é o centro de mercado e de serviços, com edifícios do tempo colonial. Ossu, nas colinas, tem clima fresco e vista para as montanhas do Mundo Perdido. Os arrozais de Uato-Lari e Uatucarbau ficam verdes depois das chuvas. Beaço e outras praias do mar de Timor são longas e tranquilas, mas as ondas e as correntes fortes obrigam quem nada a ter cuidado. Muitos viajantes chegam a Viqueque pela estrada de Baucau, passando por Venilale e Ossu.
text.en: Viqueque town, a little inland from the coast, is the market and service centre, with buildings from colonial times. Ossu, in the hills, has a cool climate and views towards the Mundo Perdido mountains. The rice fields of Uato-Lari and Uatucarbau turn green after the rains. Beaço and other beaches on the Timor Sea are long and quiet, but strong waves and currents mean swimmers must be careful. Many travellers reach Viqueque by the road from Baucau through Venilale and Ossu.
text.id: Kota Viqueque, agak ke pedalaman dari pantai, adalah pusat pasar dan layanan, dengan bangunan dari masa kolonial. Ossu, di perbukitan, beriklim sejuk dan menghadap ke pegunungan Mundo Perdido. Sawah di Uato-Lari dan Uatucarbau menghijau setelah hujan. Beaço dan pantai-pantai lain di Laut Timor panjang dan tenang, tetapi ombak dan arus yang kuat membuat perenang harus berhati-hati. Banyak pelancong mencapai Viqueque melalui jalan dari Baucau lewat Venilale dan Ossu.
